title: 中国人的夏夜①麻辣小龙虾：6万家店，卖的是一整个夏天 | Summer Nights P1 · Crayfish 🦞
description:
你的城市，哪家小龙虾最顶？评论区报个店名。

【中国人的夏夜 第1集 麻辣小龙虾】全国小龙虾专门店已经超过6.1万家，一年吃掉约375万吨——中国人的夏夜，几乎都是从一盆红开始的。麻辣、十三香、蒜蓉，剥壳吮指，越剥越上头。旺季从春末一直烫到初秋。说穿了，这盆虾吃的是氛围：一盆虾、一桌人、一整个夏天。所以那6万家店，卖的其实是夏夜。

Ep.1 Spicy crayfish. China now has over 61,000 crayfish specialty shops and eats around 3.75 million tons a year — and the summer night usually starts with one red tray. Spicy, thirteen-spice, or garlic; you peel, you suck your fingers, you can't stop. In season from late spring into early autumn. Honestly, what you're eating is the mood: one tray, one table, one whole summer. Those 60,000 shops are really selling summer nights.

AI-assisted edit; the bilingual subtitles are the narration — no voiceover. Facts checked this run; sources below. Food & consumer-trend note, no investment or franchise advice. Footage licensed from Pexels (credited below).
